_comment: Washington has no state income tax on wages.
name: Washington
notes: Washington doesn't tax wages. Its capital gains tax only reaches high earners selling investments, not your paycheck.
Washington does have two payroll deductions that other no-tax states don't: WA Cares (long-term care, 0.58% of wages) and the Paid Family and Medical Leave premium.
notIncluded: This estimate leaves out WA Cares and the Paid Family and Medical Leave premium, so your real check will be roughly 1–1.5% lower.
